prompt: What is the key difference between an MCP allow list and tool permissions?
explanation: Two distinct access control layers. Allow list = server reachability. Tool permissions = operation scope within a permitted server. Both required for complete least-privilege.

options.text: Allow list controls which MCP servers the agent can reach; tool permissions control what each permitted server can do — both layers needed
Allow list stores API keys; permissions store model settings
Allow lists are cloud-only; permissions work everywhere
